sources.role: pinned maintained mirror of the legacy Triforce branch: user roots, INI config, controller profiles, Triforce cards and state paths
build and command-line documentation for the pinned branch

paths.path: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dolphin-emu/Config/Dolphin.ini and GCPadNew.ini (or $HOME/.config/dolphin-emu/; legacy $HOME/.dolphin-emu is selected when it already exists)
paths.naming: Dolphin Common::IniFile sections/key=value; game settings under Config/GameSettings and controller profiles under Config/Profiles/GCPad
ControllerEmu INI sections (GCPad1..4) with Device and source-defined control expressions; profile [Profile] sections can be selected via Controls/PadProfileN

paths.path: $XDG_DATA_HOME/dolphin-emu/GC/SRAM.raw and Triforce/ (tricard_* and tribackup_* files), unless DOLPHIN_EMU_USERPATH or portable mode overrides the user root
paths.naming: GC SRAM is SRAM.raw; Triforce baseboard/card stores use source-generated tricard_*/tribackup_* names
<six-character game id>.sNN slots (NN zero-padded); lastState.sav and undo.dtm are additional frontend state files

paths.path: Sys/GC/<EUR|USA|JAP|JPN>/IPL_TRI.bin under the Dolphin system directory, or equivalent configured Sys root
paths.naming: Triforce IPL is IPL_TRI.bin; region directory is selected by source boot/config code

paths.path: No external encryption-key file required for Triforce
%APPDATA%\Dolphin Emulator\Config\Dolphin.ini and GCPadNew.ini; portable.txt beside executable switches to <exe>\User\
paths.naming: Dolphin Common::IniFile grammar; profiles in Config\Profiles\GCPad\
GCPad1..4 ControllerEmu sections and [Profile] INI grammar; physical devices are source expressions, not invented IDs
SRAM.raw plus source-generated Triforce tricard_*/tribackup_* files

paths.path: Dolphin Sys\GC\<region>\IPL_TRI.bin beside the executable/system root
~/Library/Application Support/Dolphin/Config/Dolphin.ini and GCPadNew.ini (portable app User/ overrides)

paths.naming: SRAM.raw plus source-generated Triforce card/backup files

linux-flatpak.reason: Pinned Triforce branch has no verified Flatpak app/package; native XDG contract is captured separately

notes: This is the legacy Dolphin Triforce branch, not ordinary Dolphin GameCube coverage. Its persistent controller grammar is the existing Dolphin GCPadNew.ini/ControllerEmu profile contract; Triforce-specific service/coin/test controls require source-defined device sections and are not silently mapped by this record.
